main.description: Get an author's private-tier posts that the requester is authorized to read, newest first. The ordering field is each post's `record.createdAt` (descending, ties broken by record key); a `createdAt` later than the time of indexing plus five minutes is clamped to that bound, and the view carries the clamped value. Requires auth by a ready community member. An unknown actor and an actor with no visible posts both return an empty feed with no cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response (createdAt::rkey of the last returned item).
Present only when the page returned at least one item and more candidates remain.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
